text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"20±0.02"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Dimension D21 carries a tolerance band of 0.04 mm on a part that is zinc plated, but the drawing does not state whether the ±0.02 mm applies before or after plating. Without this allowance the finished size may fall out of tolerance after coating. The designer should add a note clarifying whether the dimension is pre-plate or post-plate, or adjust the tolerance to account for the plating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying that D21 is a pre-plate dimension and include the expected plating build-up, or widen the tolerance to accommodate the coating."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-\n1) TO BE TEMPERED UPTO 24-32 HRC.\n2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N1 specifies tempering to 24-32 HRC but does not state at which stage in manufacturing the heat treatment is to be performed (e.g., before final machining, before surface treatment). This matters because the sequence affects dimensional stability and machinability. The designer should add the process stage to the heat-treatment instruction.","recommended_correction":"Revise N1 to state when the tempering is to be done relative to machining and surface treatment, for example 'TO BE TEMPERED TO 24-32 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING AND BEFORE FINAL MACHINING.'"}]}
